items.caption:
Clocks go back on Sunday Oct 25: do you get an extra hour of sleep?
In Central Europe 3:00 becomes 2:00 (UK 2:00 to 1:00; US and Canada Nov 1). A 2013 review found little sign of extra sleep, and earlier wake-ups for about five days.
